_readme: Live Call Coach playbook (call_coach.py). 'offer' is what the coach is allowed to quote -- fill it with real Planet Networks plans and facts; anything left blank shows as [fill in: ...] on the card instead of being made up. 'objections' are the instant keyword cards; 'listen_for' entries are matched case-insensitively against what the customer just said.

objections.label: Price
objections.say: Totally fair -- what are you paying now, and what speed do you actually get? {value_line} If budget's the main thing, {cheapest_plan}.
objections.why: Anchor on what they pay today for what they get, then offer the smaller plan instead of a discount.

objections.label: Locked into a contract
objections.say: Makes sense. When does it end? {switching_help} We can get you on the install calendar now so you're ready the day it's up.
objections.why: Turns 'not now' into a booked date; the contract becomes a timing question, not a no.

objections.label: Happy with current provider
objections.say: Good to hear it's working. Quick question -- how is it in the evening when everyone's online, and how's the upload on video calls? {value_line}
objections.why: Don't argue with 'happy'; ask about the moments where cable or DSL usually struggles.

objections.label: Doubts it's faster
objections.say: Fair question. It's fiber to the house, so the speed you pay for is what you get. How many people and devices are on it at once? {proof}
objections.why: Make it about their household's real usage, not a speed number.

objections.label: Install worries
objections.say: Totally understand. {install_line} What day of the week usually works best for you?
objections.why: Answer the specific worry, then move straight to picking a day.

objections.label: Needs to think
objections.say: Of course. So I know what to send you -- is it the price, the timing, or something about switching? We can hold an install date with no commitment.
objections.why: Find the real objection behind 'let me think', then lower the risk of saying yes.

objections.label: Someone else decides
objections.say: That makes sense. What do you think they'll want to know? If it helps, I can call back when you're both around -- when's a good time?
objections.why: Arm them for the conversation and get a specific callback time with the decider.

objections.label: Renter / landlord
objections.say: Lots of our customers rent. Do you know who manages the property? We can tell you exactly what the install involves so you can check with them.
objections.why: Renting is a process question, not a no -- keep it moving with the next step.

objections.label: Send me info
objections.say: Happy to. So it's useful and not just a brochure -- what's the one thing you'd want to compare? And let's pencil in a quick call after you've looked.
objections.why: 'Send info' is often a polite exit; make it specific and keep a next step.

objections.label: TV / bundle
objections.say: Good question -- what do you watch most? A lot of people keep their channels by streaming on fiber. What does your bundle cost all-in today?
objections.why: Bundles hide the internet price; find out what they really use and pay for.

consent_line: Before we start, this call may be transcribed so I can take good notes. Is that okay?
